title: Refuse resumed effects when the authorization epoch advanced
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs `auth_epoch_resume` so a graph checkpoint stamped at epoch 2 refuses resume under epoch 3 before any runner is invoked. Tracks MH-DOTS-06[^insp-dots-06].
implementation: `GraphExecutor.run(resume=True, envelope=...)` returns `failed` with `authorization_epoch_mismatch`. Product verb `auth_epoch_resume`; story `environment.authorization_epoch` can stamp Config envelopes.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `auth_epoch_resume_refuse.yaml` drives `auth_epoch_resume`; expects resume_status failed and error_contains mismatch.
